Alex (Sales): Hey team — customer asks for our SOC 2 report before POC kickoff. They also want to sign an NDA today. Can we share the report now or do we need the signed NDA first?
Mike (Presales): short answer: we can share a redacted SOC2 extract but legal needs an executed NDA for full report. We usually offer a temporary bridge/assurance note if they need immediate confirmation.
Tara (Security): @Alex and @Mike — security policy: full SOC 2 (with control mappings) requires NDA. Redacted summary + control list OK to send. If they request evidence artifacts (config, logs) that's only after an agreement. :lock:
Eve (Legal): We can do a short interim assurance letter (we call it an "interim SOC2 acknowledgement") that confirms we have a current SOC 2 and that evidence access will be provided post-NDA. If they want rapid access, ask them to sign our standard mutual NDA (one-pager). If they provide their NDA, legal needs 48h review.
Alex (Sales): Customer is pushing — they want something signed now to unblock procurement. What language do we put in the interim letter?
Eve (Legal): Keep it minimal. Suggested snippet: `Redwood Inference confirms it maintains a current SOC 2 Type II report. Access to detailed reports and evidence artifacts will be provided subject to a mutually executed NDA. This letter is for interim assurance only and does not substitute a signed confidentiality agreement.` You can paste that, no edits.
Mike (Presales): I'll attach a redacted SOC2 summary. Tara — how should we redact?
Tara (Security): Remove vendor-specific IPs, internal network ranges, and any customer-identifying examples. Replace with placeholders. Example path to upload redacted file: `s3://redwood-internal/soc2-exports/sales-handoffs/1842507777/` — set ACL to restricted. Also add a checksum file.
Sam (SRE): FYI, if they ask for logs we can provide 30-day rolling extracts. Those live in a separate bucket and require an access ticket from security + signed NDA.
audit-bot: Document uploaded: redacted_SOC2_summary_v2026-03-12.pdf -> s3://redwood-internal/soc2-exports/sales-handoffs/1842507777/redacted_SOC2_summary_v2026-03-12.pdf
Alex (Sales): Thanks — I'll send the interim letter + link to the redacted PDF and request NDA signature. I'll also mention the 48h legal review if they send their own NDA.
Mike (Presales): Suggested customer message: "Thanks — attached is Redwood's interim SOC2 acknowledgement and a redacted summary. For full report access we require a signed mutual NDA; happy to review yours within 48 hours."
Eve (Legal): Also add: please confirm point of contact and expected date for POC start. Helps prioritize review.
Alex (Sales): Copying in the customer now. Will ping here if anything unexpected. :thumbsup:
